title: Innokin Endura V Box Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Endura V Box Pod Kit is an elegant, compact version of the popular Endura V kit, designed with a unique ‘matchbox’ style that’s as portable as it is practical. Built to satisfy both new vapers and experienced users alike, the Endura V Box features a 1400mAh rechargeable battery that supports effortless all-day vaping, while its 2ml pods deliver the perfect balance of convenience and consistent performance. What sets the Endura V Box apart from similar devices is its flexible design and customisable aesthetics. The replaceable side panels let you switch up the look of your kit effortlessly, providing a personal touch to suit your style. Innokin has also equipped this kit with adjustable airflow settings, which combined with the VCAP pods allow you to switch from a flavour-rich mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw to a smooth restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) inhale, depending on your preference and your pod’s resistance. This versatility makes the Endura V Box ideal for users seeking both an intense throat hit with Nic Salt e-liquids or a balanced, smooth vape with high-PG blends. The Endura V Box uses 2ml VCAP refillable pods that are easy to replace, offering quick refills with minimal fuss. If you’re looking for a reliable all-day vape and a device that combines portability with flexible style, the Innokin Endura V Box ticks all the boxes. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
